title: Singular control with state-dependent costs for Lévy processes
summary: We study a discounted singular stochastic control problem driven by a general Lévy process, where the objective is to minimize a cost functional composed of a running cost and a control cost that depends on the current state of the process. We first establish a Hamilton Jacobi Bellman (HJB)-type verification theorem providing sufficient conditions under which a reflecting barrier strategy is optimal and characterizing the value function.
